Incumbent governor [[Ben Nelson]] won re-election to a second term in a landslide, defeating Republican businessman Gene Spence by 47.4 percentage points and sweeping all but two counties ([[Garden County, Nebraska|Garden]] and [[Sheridan County, Nebraska|Sheridan]]), despite the concurrent [[Republican Revolution|1994 Republican Revolution]].
